run_qr_webserver: run the QR code webserver on a custom port with info text via argparse CLI
generate_qrcode_image: generate a QR code PNG image from arbitrary info text and save to the current directory
update_qrcode_only: update an existing QR code image without restarting the webserver using the -update flag
serve_qrcode_html: serve an HTML page with an embedded QR code image via a built-in HTTP server on port 8000
handle_png_requests: handle GET requests for PNG image files and serve them with the correct content-type header
